GamesGoodboy GalaxyVersionNintendo SwitchEditionDigitalAnimated Blood, Comic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceLoadingNintendo Switch 2 Compatibility InformationSupported – Game behavior is consistent with Nintendo Switch. Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces. A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Nintendo Switch™, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.Maxwell’s homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last ditch-effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself on the edge of a hostile system - if there’s any hope of return and rescue he’ll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find.Forced to confront this celestial expanse head on, Maxwell stays strong - determined to keep his head up and lend a helping hand to everyone he meets on his journey. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can’t keep a good dog down.Key Features· Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes· Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards· Upgrade your blaster with special abilities· Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles· Local couch co-op multiplayer mode· Bonus prequel content: Chapter ZeroSoftware description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)Nintendo Switch: 337 MBNintendo Switch 2: 337 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeSoftware compatibility and play experience may differ on Nintendo Switch Lite. Additional accessories may be required(sold separately). See support for details.No. of playersSingle system (1-2)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. All users should read the Health and Safety Information available in the system settings before using this software.

source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 5 to 9
source.evidenceText: Mike Nelson, XBOX Wire Editor October 2, 2026 · 7 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Gears of War: E-Day Pre-Order Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 4036 ★★★★★ Get it now Gears of War: E-Day – October 6Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet. STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ Secret Mode ☆☆☆☆☆ 243 ★★★★★ Get it now STAR WARS: Galactic Racer – October 6 A ​​runs-based​​, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim of the ​​STAR WARS​​ galaxy.​​​​ The Empire’s grip on the galaxy has finally broken, and with its fall comes a new obsession: speed. As the New Republic struggles to rebuild, gambling, entertainment, and glory fuel a booming underground. Out of this chaos, the Galactic League is born: an unsanctioned racing circuit where syndicates sponsor pilots, fortunes are won and lost in seconds, and only the bold survive. No Force. No prophecy. Just skill, strategy, and the will to rise. KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. ☆☆☆☆☆ 61 ★★★★★ $74.99 Get it now KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] – October 6XBOX Play Anywhere A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC). Echo Weaver Akupara Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 138 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial Echo Weaver – October 8Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop. Hidden Dogs Silesia Games Sp. z o.o. ☆☆☆☆☆ 16 ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Hidden Dogs – October 7 Welcome to puppy village! Labby needs your help with a top-secret mission: creating a video game just for dogs (move over, cats!). Find 500+ hidden dogs and items scattered across 15 cozy, hand-drawn levels in the English countryside. Got stuck? Just blow the dog whistle! Keep finding pups to watch the map grow and come to life with moving planes, boats, and trains! Titanic Escape Simulator MagicProStudio ☆☆☆☆☆ 23 ★★★★★ $24.99 Get it now Titanic Escape Simulator – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere You are a private investigator aboard the world’s most famous ocean liner. What begins as a routine voyage soon becomes something far darker: a suspicious death, hidden clues, locked rooms, restricted decks, and a mystery buried deep within the ship. Explore the Titanic before disaster strikes. Question passengers, search cabins, uncover secrets, and follow a trail that leads from the elegance of First Class to the shadowed lower decks below. But as the truth begins to surface, so does the danger. Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire JanduSoft ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire – October 7XBOX Play Anywhere An action-farming-roguelite set in Transylvania, the homeland of Dracula and his rebellious lastborn son, Voltaire. An epiphany results in a change of heart for the young vampire: abandoning blood in favor of a plant-based diet out of spite to prove to his father that neck-biting is not the only way for vampires to thrive. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival Saber Interactive Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 354 ★★★★★ Get it now Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival – October 8 Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Play the story of Aidan, who must use the power of a mysterious puzzle box – the Genesis Configuration – to help his girlfriend Sunny’s escape from the otherworldly hellscape of the Labyrinth. Wield the powers of the box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead and do battle with the horrific cult devoted to the Cenobites. Neon Abyss 2 Kepler Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 294 ★★★★★ $19.99 $15.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Neon Abyss 2 – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Dive deeper into the chaotic, beautifully pixelated Abyss with Neon Abyss 2! The action is faster, the stakes are higher, and the possibilities are endless in this cybermyth roguelike. With explosive run ‘n’ gun gameplay, diverse combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, Neon Abyss 2 delivers a dramatic, thrill-packed experience every time you enter. Deck of Haunts DANGEN Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ 27 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now Deck of Haunts – October 8 Deck of Haunts invites you to step into the eerie role of a malevolent Haunted House, where the walls whisper secrets and terror lurks around every corner. As the master of this cursed domain, your goal is to ensnare daring humans, play on their fears, and drain their very essence to expand your dark influence. Forever Ago Annapurna Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 397 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Forever Ago – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption. In this single-player road trip adventure, you’ll travel to beautiful places, capture memories with your camera, meet interesting characters, and even make some new friends. Gear.Club Unlimited 3 Nacon ☆☆☆☆☆ 10 ★★★★★ Get it now Gear.Club Unlimited 3 – October 8XBOX Play Anywhere
